CustomField.description: TNCI-206 / ELV-DM-010. Nue port of CPQ Eligible_for_Renewal_ARR__c. Renewal test uses Ruby__ChangeType__c containing 'Renew' (matches Renew and RenewWithQuantityUpdate) instead of a subscription lookup. Summary Items excluded from ARR aggregation.
CustomField.formula: AND( NOT( ELV_Exclude_from_ARR__c ), Ruby__ActualQuantity__c <> 0, NOT( ISPICKVAL( Ruby__LineType__c, "SummaryItem" ) ), NOT( ELV_Is_Cloned_Quote_Line__c ), CONTAINS( TEXT( Ruby__ChangeType__c ), "Renew" ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: TRUE when this line is a renewal eligible for renewal ARR. Summary Items are excluded.
CustomField.label: ELV Eligible for Renewal ARR Calc
